test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a rectangular table. R is sitting at the north-west, R and P are placed diagonally opposite each other, whereas V and U are placed diagonally opposite each other. W faces the west direction, Q faces the east direction, and S is sitting between R and V. In which direction does T sit?
solution:
Eight persons: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W

1) R is sitting at the north-west, R and P are placed diagonally opposite each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f16e11d2b23c829524779e708080ddae696f85645545eeddc692a0f2e3414007.png] 

2) V and U are placed diagonally opposite each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/366cccdb44949dd35ca71524c25a283bb1b49da64950f000168f2c980dd64bf1.png] 

3) W faces the west direction. Q faces the east direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60f0e684e0d9b68685c1cb38ddd627c054859cfc342874d8fed0a1966bebd1a2.png] 

4) S is sitting between R and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3348cdeb6139c21f437a03d8a6f12576f7f6fb369b9d84b734eaacf79e97b520.png] 

Final sitting arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa055a6a74e01f7cec1d738a0bd961b93796c43a60fc1d72380b2ca269cb5ffb.png] 

Hence, T sits in the '**South' **direction.
